# V3 runtime characterization — requirement-to-test matrix

Tests live in `crates/ocg-core/tests/v3_runtime_invariants.rs`,
`crates/ocg-core/tests/v3_control_plane.rs`, and test modules in
`forwarder.rs` / `usage_sync.rs`. They are deterministic and offline.

| Requirement | Status | Tests |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Request-entry snapshot: `ForwardRouteSet` | Existing | `gateway_fallback::list_mode_midflight_config_switch_keeps_the_entry_snapshot`; free fallback re-leg `list_mode_free_fallback_reroutes_to_the_default_leg_mid_request` |
| Request-entry snapshot: `AppConfig` (proxy/routing clients) | Existing | Same proxy snapshot tests. Timeouts/sticky flags ride the same captured `config` value in `execute_plan`; not separately mid-flight tested. |
| Request-entry snapshot: pricing | New | `v3_runtime_invariants::entry_pricing_snapshot_survives_midflight_activation` |
| Request-entry snapshot: provider contracts | New | `v3_runtime_invariants::entry_contracts_snapshot_survives_midflight_protocol_disable` |
| Request-entry snapshot: alias / Zen catalog | New | `v3_runtime_invariants::entry_alias_snapshot_survives_midflight_zen_catalog_replace` |
| Per-fallback re-read: accounts | New | `v3_runtime_invariants::fallback_rereads_accounts_and_skips_a_card_disabled_mid_request` |
| Per-fallback re-read: Custom runtime | New | `v3_runtime_invariants::custom_401_rotates_persists_auth_error_and_skips_a_runtime_disabled_mid_request` |
| Per-fallback re-read: Free cooldown | New | `v3_runtime_invariants::fallback_rereads_free_cooldown_and_skips_zen` (plus existing `zen_free_429_is_anonymous_and_cools_the_singleton_egress_route`, `ordered_zen_candidate_429_falls_through_to_the_next_normal_card`) |
| `forward_once` is one upstream call | Existing | Call counts in `connect_failure_retries_once_without_account_fallback`, `stream_ending_before_downstream_output_retries_same_account_once`, `inference_403_fails_over_without_persisting_an_auth_breaker`, v3 fallback tests (`calls == attempt count`) |
| Same-account retry at most once and only before downstream bytes | Existing | `stream_ending_before_downstream_output_retries_same_account_once`, `stream_ending_twice_before_downstream_output_stops_after_one_retry`, `connect_failure_retries_once_without_account_fallback`, `streaming_connect_failure_is_safe_to_retry_once` |
| Partial SSE never falls back | Existing + new | `interrupted_stream_is_outcome_unknown_and_not_replayed`, `v2_alias_plan_contracts::alias_stream_does_not_cross_account_retry_after_output`, `custom_trusted_admin::custom_stream_does_not_cross_account_retry_after_output`, `v3_runtime_invariants::downstream_disconnect_finalizes_the_streaming_row_without_fallback` |
| `StreamOutcomeGuard` finalization on disconnect | New | Unit: `forwarder::stream_outcome_guard_tests::{drop_without_terminal_finalizes_outcome_unknown, drop_after_terminal_usage_prices_from_stream_state_not_the_converter, disarm_leaves_the_streaming_row_untouched}`. Public HTTP abort is not a reliable probe: Hyper keeps polling a pending SSE body until the next chunk, so a client close is often observed only after the stream has already become terminal. |
| Independent bounded usage capture | Existing + new | `forwarder::stream_usage_tests::{single_chunk_extracts_usage, chunk_boundary_handling, buffer_bound_clears_on_oversize, large_reasoning_chunk_still_captures_trailing_usage}`; converter `protocol_stream::chat_converter_captures_trailing_include_usage_chunk`; Drop path uses `StreamState` without `StreamConverter` (`drop_after_terminal_usage_prices_from_stream_state_not_the_converter`) |
| `success_no_usage` | Partial existing + new | Zen without usage stays `success`/`free` (`zen_free_non_stream_success_without_usage_is_still_zero_cost_free`, stream twin). Go without usage is `success_no_usage`/`usage_missing`: `v3_runtime_invariants::go_success_without_usage_is_success_no_usage_for_non_stream_and_stream` |
| Key-match CAS | Existing | DB: `db::set_account_auth_error_if_key_matches` tests; `delayed_dashboard_ping_429_does_not_cool_down_replaced_key`; `usage_sync::key_cas_leaves_windows_unchanged_when_account_changes`; `custom_verification_cas_rejects_stale_key_config_caps_and_delete`; dashboard official usage CAS |
| OpenCode 401 passthrough (no rotate, no `auth_error`) | Existing | `inference_401_is_returned_without_failover_or_breaker`, `registered_zen_model_401_is_returned_without_credential_fallback_or_breaker`, `zen_free_401_and_403_stop_without_touching_a_normal_credential` |
| Ordinary 401 rotation + `auth_error` | New | `v3_runtime_invariants::custom_401_rotates_persists_auth_error_and_skips_a_runtime_disabled_mid_request`. Ping 401 breaker remains `dashboard_ping_401_sets_auth_error_and_success_clears_it` |
| Go 429 window parse + rotate | Existing | `falls_back_past_five_limited_accounts_to_sixth_success`, `all_limited_accounts_return_429_with_soonest_reset` |
| Zen Free 429 (IP-shared, no key rotate, exhaust channel) | Existing | `zen_free_429_is_anonymous_and_cools_the_singleton_egress_route`, `ordered_zen_candidate_429_falls_through_to_the_next_normal_card`, `forwarder::free_429_does_not_rotate_keys` |
| Generic 429 (Custom/GOAT, no Go windows) | Existing | `custom_trusted_admin::custom_429_is_generic_and_does_not_parse_go_windows`, `forwarder::goat_429_is_generic_and_ignores_go_limit_windows` |
| Deferred post-429 usage sync (not inline, 1–2 min, no cooldown rewrite) | Existing + new | Unit: `usage_sync::schedule_after_inference_429_only_pulls_next_eligible`, `inference_429_intentionally_overrides_failure_backoff_floor`, `inference_429_delay_stays_within_one_to_two_minutes`. Gateway path: `v3_runtime_invariants::go_inference_429_schedules_deferred_usage_sync_without_an_inline_fetch` |
| Unknown / ambiguous model zero-call | Existing | `unknown_model_is_rejected_before_any_upstream_attempt`, `v2_alias_plan_contracts::ambiguous_raw_upstream_id_is_rejected`, `v2_alias_runtime::ambiguous_model_id_is_structured_across_client_formats`, `custom_trusted_admin::goat_raw_overlap_with_custom_is_ambiguous_and_does_not_call_upstream` |
| Local-only model lists | Existing | `model_discovery_returns_local_list_with_zero_accounts`, `model_discovery_does_not_create_inference_logs`, `application_models_is_local_with_zero_accounts`, `application_models_does_not_select_accounts_or_hit_upstream`, `v2_alias_plan_contracts::client_models_list_exposes_aliases_not_raw_upstream_ids` |
| One attempt row per actual upstream attempt | Existing + new | `connect_failure_retries_once_without_account_fallback` (attempts `[1,2]`), stream retry twins, `fallback_rereads_accounts_and_skips_a_card_disabled_mid_request` |
| Redaction | Existing | `successful_inference_never_echoes_the_selected_account_key`, stream split-key / unterminated tail / common-short-key tests, `v2_alias_plan_contracts::account_secrets_absent_from_json_errors_and_logs`, `diagnostics` unit tests |
| Control revision / CAS | Existing + new | `dashboard_auth::account_crud_exposes_and_enforces_shared_revision_without_breaking_legacy_calls`, settings/key/provider-contract CAS tests, `v3_control_plane::dashboard_cas_is_not_shared_with_cli_or_tauri_shaped_db_writes` (its historical name characterizes direct `Database` writes; current CLI mutations use `account_control`, and Tauri has no invoke mutation surface) |
| Usage worker once-per-`CoreState` | New | `usage_sync::spawn_usage_sync_loop_starts_once_per_core_state` |
| Dashboard vs CLI and legacy direct-DB mutation differences | New | `v3_control_plane::dashboard_cas_is_not_shared_with_cli_or_tauri_shaped_db_writes`, `tauri_and_cli_shaped_creates_differ_from_dashboard_enablement`, `dashboard_custom_create_stays_disabled_pending_unlike_tauri_shaped_db_create`. The historical test identifiers characterize direct database behavior only; they do not describe a live Tauri command surface. Dashboard enablement policy also `dashboard::create_account_saves_verification_required_plans_as_disabled_drafts` |
| Access-key persistence (schema v27) | Existing | `dashboard_v3_keys::{dashboard_v3_schema_version_stays_at_v27, dashboard_v3_create_rename_enable_disable_delete_and_regenerate, dashboard_v3_primary_key_cannot_be_disabled_or_deleted}`; DB migration/invariants: `db::{v27_fresh_database_skips_pre_v3_backup_and_has_one_primary, v26_to_v27_copies_keys_drops_columns_and_writes_hashed_backup, v27_primary_row_cannot_be_disabled_or_deleted}`. Primary and sub Key rows persist in `access_keys`, not `sub_gateway_keys`. |

## Not covered by this requirement map (without production edits or other crates)

| Gap | Why |
| --- | --- |
| Live CLI `key add/enable` binary | `crates/ocg-cli` is outside this requirement map. Its in-process tests exercise the shared `account_control` service; this matrix does not execute the compiled binary. |
| Exact `forward_once` function identity after a rename | Behavioral: one HTTP call per attempt is frozen; the symbol name is not. |
| Hyper/reqwest abort vs `StreamOutcomeGuard` on a live SSE body | Hyper continues polling a pending chunked body after client close until the next frame; Drop-without-terminal is frozen by unit tests, not a public HTTP abort. |
| In-flight `routing_mode` / timeout scalar snapshot | Captured `AppConfig` is the same object as the proxy snapshot; a dedicated mid-flight routing-mode test would be weaker than the existing route-set test. |
| Inference 401 key-match CAS race | Delayed ping 429 CAS and DB `set_account_auth_error_if_key_matches` cover the primitive; a delayed Custom 401 + key replace is omitted to avoid a second scripted-origin race. |
